title: The CLI scan command uses the scanner package
description:
As a CLI user, I want scan <path> to behave as it does today, so that the split is invisible at the command line.

Feature: CLI consumer

  Scenario: Same command
    Given a project path
    When I run the CLI scan command
    Then it calls @dataparade/scanner
    And it still writes dataflow.json and can upload

  Scenario: No second engine
    Given the CLI repository
    Then it does not contain a second copy of ingest, analyzers, or patterns
